liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Vince's Wife Shows Up** (1 review): Vince's wife vents to Jerry about accountants [6]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Bob and Jerry settle into a groove here, which the reviewer finds genuinely magical [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Jerry And Vince Talking**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **Jerry And Vince Talking**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **Jerry And Vince Playing**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **Vince's Wife Shows Up**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **Vince Playing**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-08-28.156714.sbd.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 9 songs; 92 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1990-08-28.157161.sbd.rehearsals.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 9 songs; 92 min [3]
- **gd1990-08-28.156714.sbd.cm.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 9 songs; 92 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Features conversational banter between Vince and Jerry during the studio session [4]
- Rare look inside the studio as Vince learns and plays along on many tunes, mostly with Jerry and Bob [5]
- Big Steve Parish and Bob make brief, funny cameos in the candid conversations [6]
- Jerry seems to enjoy teaching Vince, who comes across as eager during their practice [6]
- Described as Vince Welnick's first rehearsal, with only part of the band present [1]
- Described as Vince Welnick's first rehearsal, with only part of the band present [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-08-28.156714.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  May 9, 2022; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-XG90) [1]. Also: The source cassette was supplied by David Beckwith [1]
- **gd1990-08-28.157161.sbd.rehearsals.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by David Beckwith for supplying the cassette; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  May 9, 2022; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-XG90) [3]. Also: This copy is a 16-bit/44.1 conversion of the 24-bit/96k transfer, release 156714 [3]
